spec.name: sprint35_taker_imbalance_liquid_etf
spec.hypothesis: Rolling 5-min taker buy/sell volume imbalance on highly liquid index ETFs predicts short-horizon (15min) continuation, net of costs — testing the new order-flow signal outside the illiquid altbasket regime that killed sprint32/34.
spec.power_argument: Universe of 4 liquid ETFs, entry_per_day_cap=10/symbol (40/day), ~10 trading days -> ~400 raw entries, >=300 after in-band holds/filters. Assumed 15min net-return stdev ~25bps (liquid ETF, lower than altbasket names). At n=300-400 and alpha=0.01 (t~2.6), min detectable edge = t*sigma/sqrt(n) ~= 3.2-3.7bps, which is above realistic T1 round-trip cost (~1-2bps) -- a clean pass/fail test, not an exp14-style unfalsifiable design.
